No spec subject
From specled_-hj4.2 verification note N3 (2026-07-25). .claude/rules/specled.md:74-80 ("state.json is generated — never hand-merge") is false on three counts, verified by execution: (a) mix spec.check never writes .spec/state.json; mix spec.validate writes it only with --output (spec.validate.ex:81); (b) it cannot conflict on rebase — untracked and .gitignore:28 ignores it; (c) "regenerate with mix spec.check and commit" is impossible. Contradicts the correct .spec/AGENTS.md:33-36. Same false section exists in project CLAUDE.md. Agent-facing rule text — fix both, and mirror to the vault-side agent-rules sync source (same handoff as the hj4.2 protocol-sentence edit).
title: Rules: fix false state.json is generated section in .claude/rules/specled.md + CLAUDE.md
